retention.panel_support: flat component-free UI PCB outer-face display bed reserved under the complete 56.54 x 84.96-mm configured panel outline
retention.primary_retention: one 0.17-mm target die-cut perimeter PSA frame directly between the panel rear perimeter and the UI PCB outer soldermask
retention.secondary_retention: none in the assembled stack; PCB assembly datums and a removable placement fixture control alignment without becoming retained parts
retention.flex_strain_relief: the tail leaves the panel toward board -Y, runs over the component-free outer-face corridor, forms one free bend loop outside the antenna-edge PCB outline, returns flat along the inner face and enters the edge-facing ZIF parallel to the PCB; no sharp crease, bare-FR4 bearing, tensile load or peel load reaches the contacts or latch
retention.service_rule: opening the sandwich exposes the ZIF latch; release the latch first, then warm and cut the PSA frame before lifting the panel, and install a fresh die-cut frame before reassembly

physical_realization.part_type: component-free region of the UI PCB outer face, not a separate purchased part
physical_realization.implementation: reserve the complete 56.54 x 84.96-mm configured panel projection as a flat soldermask-controlled landing area; the adhesive zone contains no components, vias, test points, copper-height steps or silkscreen, and placement datums remain outside the panel outline
physical_realization.load_role: supports the panel and transfers normal, touch and handling loads directly into the UI PCB

physical_realization.part_type: carrier-backed double-coated acrylic display-bonding tape, converter die-cut as a peelable frame
physical_realization.implementation: 0.17-mm target thickness; nominal 2.0-mm perimeter band on the documented safe rear perimeter, interrupted at the antenna-edge FPC exit; no liquid glue and no adhesive on the active glass, FPC or rear components
physical_realization.load_role: retains the panel against lift and in-plane shear and distributes touch load into the PCB bed
physical_realization.material_candidate_not_yet_selected: 3M 9495LE is a technically suitable 0.17-mm die-cuttable display-bonding candidate, but is not an accepted production MPN or JLCPCB placement route yet
physical_realization.release_gate: freeze the exact adhesive grade, converter cut drawing, cleaning/pressure/dwell process and written one-prototype assembler acceptance before order

physical_realization.part_type: PCB keep-out corridor plus optional removable low-tack polyimide assembly guide
physical_realization.implementation: reserve the complete outer-face run, free-loop volume beyond board -Y and inner-face run to the edge-facing ZIF; the tail must not pass under PSA, touch the bare routed FR4 edge or receive a hard fold. A removable low-tack polyimide guide may hold the free loop during insertion but is not structural
physical_realization.load_role: prevents panel motion from becoming tensile or peel load at the ZIF contacts

fpc_route_side_section.route: panel rear tail -> component-free UI-PCB outer-face corridor -> free loop outside antenna edge / board -Y -> flat UI-PCB inner-face run -> edge-facing ZIF
fpc_route_side_section.bend_radius_gate: H5 must bind the free-loop radius and enclosure keep-out to the current-lot FPC construction before release; the drawing deliberately does not invent an unsupported radius

retention.structural_load_path: finger or handling load -> panel rear perimeter -> die-cut PSA frame -> UI PCB -> sandwich stops and fasteners; never through the FPC or ZIF

esp32_div_v2_reference.panel_mount: raw 2.8-inch display body seated directly on the main PCB
esp32_div_v2_reference.in_plane_location: four empty 1.2-mm holes surround the display zone on a 49.10 x 68.25-mm rectangle; the official Gerber drill file marks them plated, but the copper flashes are only drill-size and the assembled-device photograph shows that they do not locate or retain the display
esp32_div_v2_reference.electrical_connection: 18-contact display FPC soldered directly to eighteen 0.4 x 4.5-mm SMD lands; no display ZIF
esp32_div_v2_reference.not_publicly_documented: the published Gerbers, PcbDoc, BOM, 3D model and assembled-device photograph do not identify a positive display retainer; the BOM contains no frame, fastener, foam or adhesive line, so a hidden PSA bond is plausible but unproven
esp32_div_v2_reference.leshy2_adoption_rule: use DIV only as evidence that a raw panel can occupy a direct PCB seat; Leshy2 explicitly defines the otherwise undocumented adhesive bond, assembly controls and a serviceable non-load-bearing ZIF

interboard_fit_audit.remaining_gate: Final PCB, assembly and enclosure tolerance stack plus assembled HIL remain required before production release.

physical_interconnect_clearance_audit.scope: Every physical item entering or occupying the 11-mm interboard channel; PCB copper is intentionally a later ECAD/DRC proof.
